test_instantiate_disassembler: test the Disassembler class by instantiating it with a CPU triple string
test_basic_disassembly: test the Disassembler.get_instruction method to disassemble a byte sequence into an instruction
test_nonexistent_triple: test the Disassembler raises an exception when given an invalid CPU triple
test_get_multiple_instructions: test the Disassembler.get_instructions method to disassemble multiple instructions from a byte sequence
test_set_options_markup: test the Disassembler.set_options method with Option_UseMarkup to enable markup in disassembly output
